info.name: Cone UI - API Documentation v1
info.description:
Complete API documentation for the Cone UI project. Covers authentication, profile, dashboard, cases, simulation, MCQ, and WebSocket endpoints.

## Base URL
`{{BASE_URL}}` = `http://localhost:3000`

## Authentication
All protected routes require:
```
Authorization: Bearer {{ACCESS_TOKEN}}
```

## Standard Response Format
```json
{
  "isSuccess": true,
  "message": "Value fetched successfully",
  "toastMessage": "Data fetched successfully",
  "data": []
}
```

## Standard POST Search Body
```json
{
  "search": { "term": "" },
  "pagination": { "page": 1, "limit": 10 },
  "sort": { "isAlphabetic": true }
}
```

item.name: 🔐 Authentication
item.description: Endpoints related to user authentication — login, signup, and OTP verification.

request.description:
Authenticates the user with email and password. Returns access token, refresh token, and expiry timestamp.

### Request Body
| Field    | Type   | Required | Description          |
|----------|--------|----------|----------------------|
| email    | string | ✅       | User's email address |
| password | string | ✅       | User's password      |

response.name: 401 - Invalid Credentials
422 - Validation Error

request.description:
Registers a new user. On success, sends an OTP to the registered email for verification.

### Request Body
| Field    | Type   | Required | Description                    |
|----------|--------|----------|--------------------------------|
| email    | string | ✅       | New user's email address       |
| password | string | ✅       | Min 8 chars, must be strong    |

response.name: 201 - Signup Successful (OTP Sent)
409 - Email Already Exists

exec: console.log('✅ Tokens saved after OTP verification');

request.description:
Verifies the OTP sent during signup. Returns access token, refresh token, and expiry on success.

### Request Body
| Field | Type   | Required | Description              |
|-------|--------|----------|--------------------------|
| email | string | ✅       | Email used during signup |
| otp   | string | ✅       | 6-digit OTP from email   |

response.name: 200 - OTP Verified
400 - Invalid or Expired OTP

variable.description: Unique ID of the case to start

request.description:
Starts a simulation session for the given `caseId`. Returns session info and initial vitals.

### Path Parameters
| Parameter | Type   | Required | Description           |
|-----------|--------|----------|-----------------------|
| caseId    | string | ✅       | Unique case ID        |

### Headers
| Header        | Value                   | Required |
|---------------|-------------------------|----------|
| Authorization | Bearer {{ACCESS_TOKEN}} | ✅       |

response.name: 200 - Simulation Started
404 - Case Not Found

item.name: 🎮 Simulation
item.description: Perform actions within an active simulation session.

variable.description: The action to perform in the simulation

request.description:
Performs a simulation action (`actionId`) in an active session. Returns feedback, updated vitals, and next available actions.

### Path Parameters
| Parameter | Type   | Required | Description                        |
|-----------|--------|----------|---------------------------------|
| actionId  | string | ✅       | Unique action ID to perform     |

### Request Body
| Field            | Type   | Required | Description                      |
|------------------|--------|----------|----------------------------------|
| sessionId        | string | ✅       | Active simulation session ID     |
| caseId           | string | ✅       | Case ID for the session          |
| metadata         | object | ❌       | Extra context/options for action |

response.name: 200 - Action Performed
200 - Simulation Complete
400 - Invalid Action

item.name: 🔌 WebSocket
item.description: Real-time vital signs streaming over WebSocket during a simulation session.

query.description: JWT Access Token for WS handshake auth

request.description:
## WebSocket — Real-Time Vital Signs

**Protocol**: `ws://` or `wss://`
**WebSocket URL**: `ws://localhost:3000/api/v1/vitalsigns?sessionId=sess_abc123&token=<ACCESS_TOKEN>`

> ⚠️ **Note**: To test this in Postman, go to **File > New > WebSocket Request** and use the WS URL above.

---

### Connection Query Parameters
| Parameter | Type   | Required | Description                         |
|-----------|--------|----------|-------------------------------------|
| sessionId | string | ✅       | Active simulation session ID        |
| token     | string | ✅       | JWT Access Token for authentication |

---

### Message Types

#### ➡️ Client → Server: Subscribe
```json
{
  "type": "subscribe",
  "sessionId": "sess_abc123"
}
```

#### ⬅️ Server → Client: Vitals Update (every ~2 seconds)
```json
{
  "type": "vitals_update",
  "sessionId": "sess_abc123",
  "timestamp": "2026-07-03T10:16:15.000Z",
  "data": {
    "heartRate": 102,
    "bloodPressure": { "systolic": 88, "diastolic": 55 },
    "oxygenSaturation": 90,
    "temperature": 37.8,
    "respiratoryRate": 26,
    "ecgWaveform": [0.1, 0.2, 0.8, 1.2, 0.5, 0.1, -0.1, 0.0]
  }
}
```

#### ⬅️ Server → Client: Simulation Complete
```json
{
  "type": "simulation_complete",
  "sessionId": "sess_abc123",
  "data": {
    "finalScore": 85,
    "grade": "A",
    "feedback": "Excellent STEMI management. Rapid cath lab activation was key."
  }
}
```

#### ➡️ Client → Server: Unsubscribe
```json
{
  "type": "unsubscribe",
  "sessionId": "sess_abc123"
}
```

#### ⬅️ Server → Client: Error
```json
{
  "type": "error",
  "code": 4001,
  "message": "Unauthorized: Invalid or expired token"
}
```

---

### WebSocket Close Codes
| Code | Reason                         |
|------|--------------------------------|
| 1000 | Normal closure                 |
| 4001 | Unauthorized / Invalid token   |
| 4004 | Session not found              |
| 4429 | Rate limit exceeded            |
| 1011 | Internal server error          |
